articles.summary: Commerce Bank today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Nolan Associates, a St. Louis-based boutique investment banking firm serving middle-market clients nationwide. The acquisition adds investment banking capabilities and enhances its ability to support business owners through growth, acquisition, capital-raising and ownership transition decisions. "We are pleased to welcome Nolan Associates to Commerce," said Bob Holmes, chairman and chief executive officer, Commerce Bank – St. Louis. "Nolan has built an outstanding reputation for trusted advice, deep industry knowledge and long-term client relationships. Their addition strengthens our ability to serve middle-market companies and business owners with a broader range of strategic and financial advisory services." Nolan Associates will retain its leadership team, employees and Brentwood, Missouri office, ensuring continuity for clients and team members. "Joining Commerce marks an exciting new chapter
articles.title: Commerce Bank Completes Acquisition of Investment Banking Firm Nolan & Associates
